pr_title: fix: fallback to cast kernel if `inline_cast` AnyValue raise
pr_body:
This fixes #13588.

To be safe, it's best to keep the fallback mechanism and gradually align inline_cast and cast kernels.

I'll implement the string/binary type AnyValue to numeric type conversion later.

issue_context.title: Casting string literal to numeric dtypes
issue_context.body:
### Checks - [X] I have checked that this issue has not already been reported. - [X] I have confirmed this bug exists on the [latest version](https://pypi.org/project/polars/) of Polars. ### Reproducible example ```python import os import polars as pl os.environ["POLARS_VERBOSE"] = "1" df = pl.DataFrame({"a": [1.4, 2.7, 3.9, 5.4]}) value = '2.0' # In the .select context: df.select(b = pl.col('a') + pl.lit(value).cast(pl.Float64)) # In the .with_columns context: df.with_columns(b = pl.col('a') + pl.lit(value).cast(pl.Float64)) # In the .filter context: df.filter(pl.col('a') > pl.lit(value).cast(pl.Float64)) ``` ### Log output ```shell { "name": "ComputeError", "message": "cannot cast non numeric any-value to numeric dtype", "stack": "--------------------------------------------------------------------------- ComputeError Traceback (most recent call last) Cell In[3], line 10 7 value = '2.0' 9 # In the .select context: ---> 10 df.select(b = pl.col('a') + pl.lit(value).cast(pl.Float64)) 12 # In the .with_columns context: 13 df.with_columns(b = pl.col('a') + pl.lit(value).cast(pl.Float64)) File ~/miniconda3/envs/proj_LMOC/lib/python3.10/site-packages/polars/dataframe/frame.py:8060, in DataFrame.select(self, *exprs, **named_exprs) 7959 def select( 7960 self, *exprs: IntoExpr | Iterable[IntoExpr], **named_exprs: IntoExpr 7961 ) -> DataFrame: 7962 \"\"\" 7963 Select columns from this DataFrame. 7964 (...) 8058 8059 \"\"\" -> 8060 return self.lazy().select(*exprs, **named_exprs).collect(_eager=True) File ~/miniconda3/envs/proj_LMOC/lib/python3.10/site-packages/polars/lazyframe/frame.py:1749, in LazyFrame.collect(self, type_coercion, predicate_pushdown, projection_pushdown, simplify_expression, slice_pushdown, comm_subplan_elim, comm_subexpr_elim, no_optimization, streaming, background, _eager) 1746 if background: 1747 return InProcessQuery(ldf.collect_concurrently()) -> 1749 return wrap_df(ldf.collect()) ComputeError: cannot cast non numeric any-value to numeric dtype" } ``` ### Issue description Casting a string literal to any numeric type within an expression returns a ComputeError in any context. When setting `strict=False` in the `.cast()` expression, null values are returned rather than an error. I noticed this change in behaviour after upgrading from python polars 0.19.19 and have identified that the bug occurs in all releases >= 0.20.0. ### Expected behavior ```python import os import polars as pl df = pl.DataFrame({"a": [1.4, 2.7, 3.9, 5.4]}) value = '2.0' # In the .select context: df.select(b = pl.col('a') + pl.lit(value).cast(pl.Float64)) ``` shape: (4, 1)

comments:
Emm, It looks like we don't have support of casting `String` to numeric type for `AnyValue`. At the same time, because of a321386c, we don't fallback to cast kernel anymore. I think at least until we fully align the `inline_cast` with the functionality of cast kernel, we should keep the fallback mechanism.

As a workaround, you can disable the optimization of `simplify_expression`.

```python
df.lazy().select(b = pl.col('a') + pl.lit(value).cast(pl.Float64)).collect(simplify_expression=False)
```
I'll put back the fallback to kernel mechanism, we could support casting string any_value to numeric later.

review_comments: We should force `strict_cast` instead of `cast` here, otherwise It is not possible to fall back to the kernel as `Err` will be convert to None.
